sample_data.method: Bundled fixture selector and JSON file upload
sample_data.reset_instructions: Choose Restore built-in sample to restore all 25 published cases and process PUB-01.

problem_solving_method: We converted the P08 statement and published clarifications into executable boundary tests, isolated a pure TypeScript grading engine from the Worker and React layers, validated fixture input with Zod, and rendered the engine's trace and checking-list output directly so the UI cannot silently reimplement the rules.

R1.evidence: public/P08_school_results_public.json; automatic PUB-01 load; case selector; Upload JSON action; src/domain/schema.ts

R2.evidence: Results tab; src/domain/grade-band.ts; src/domain/evaluate-subject.ts; src/domain/evaluate-student.ts; 32 automated tests

R3.evidence: Results > Inspect; src/client/components/StudentTraceDialog.tsx; PUB-01/S004 visibly shows 4.67 uncancelled GPA and MAT failure override to 0.00/F

R4.evidence: Checking lists tab; src/domain/checking-lists.ts; optional GP <= 2, practical < 8 and AB lists allow overlap

team_members.major_contribution: Team lead; problem analysis, implementation direction, AI Integration and verification, UI Direction and implementation.

major_design_decisions: Keep grading logic in a pure TypeScript functional core with no React, Hono, D1 or Cloudflare dependencies.
Return real-number rule explanations from the domain engine and render them directly in the calculation trace.
Preserve AB as a distinct state from numeric zero.
Use the published clarification's three independent checking-list criteria.
Deploy React static assets and the Hono API together as one Cloudflare Worker.
Use D1 only for reproducible source/result run snapshots rather than a normalized school CRUD model.
known_limitations: The registered-member list must be checked against the official roster before submission.
The printable individual marksheet bonus is not implemented.
Invalid uploads are explained but corrected outside the application and uploaded again.

ai_tools_used.used_for: Specification extraction, architecture, implementation, automated tests, UI construction, documentation and verification.
ai_tools_used.how_output_was_verified: Checked against the supplied P08 statement and clarifications; 32 Vitest tests including all 25 published cases; ESLint; TypeScript; production build; local Worker and D1; desktop and 390px browser checks.

declaration: The information above is complete and truthful to the best of the team's knowledge, subject to the explicitly listed pre-submission roster check.
